svg.desc: An OpenAPI spec document is fed through a linter gate into a report where three checks pass, one check fails in red, and a reference arrow curls out of the spec to an unresolved node marked with a red cross. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Redocly CLI: the honest review”. A quantized lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3792282443.
